articles.title: Isaacman opens door to alternatives to moving shuttle Discovery to Houston
articles.summary:
NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman suggested he would be open to transferring a spacecraft other than the space shuttle Discovery to Houston.
The post Isaacman opens door to alternatives to moving shuttle Discovery to Houston appeared first on SpaceNews.

articles.title: Space-traveled mouse gives birth as China names pioneering "flying mice" crew
articles.summary:
Tokyo, Japan (SPX) Dec 30, 2025


Of the four mice that recently flew aboard China's space station, one female has now given birth to healthy offspring on Earth, in a mission that also saw the public help name the pioneering "flying mice" crew.
